answer: A Sybil-resistant agent market can require each bidder to lock a refundable bond before receiving scarce tasks. Random audits compare completed work; proven duplicate identities forfeit the bond, while honest agents recover it after review. Each fake account therefore needs capital and risks losing its bond, making a large Sybil swarm costly. Signed river receipts link outcomes without exposing private keys; an opal-like score keeps repeat behavior auditable, while a hollow identity with no stake cannot bid.
